# Shaun Fischmann

> Partnership Manager and Senior Developer at Apimo with 12+ years of experience in PropTech, enterprise real estate CRMs, API integrations, and modern web development. Based in the South of France.

## Profile & Contact

- **Name**: Shaun Fischmann
- **Role**: Partnership Manager & Developer @ [Apimo](https://www.apimo.com)
- **Location**: South of France (Nice, Cannes, Monaco area)
- **Languages**: English (fluent), French (fluent), Spanish, Chinese

## Overview

Shaun bridges software engineering and business development in the PropTech sector. With tens of thousands of commits and millions of lines of code contributed over a decade at Apimo, he oversees the integration lifecycle of partner ecosystems (real estate portals, AI services, PropTech vendors) while remaining hands-on with API architecture, full-stack development, and technical specifications. Alongside engineering, he produces generative AI visual artworks and experimental short films under the pseudonym **Shaun.AI**.

## Core Technical Skills

- **Backend & Database**: PHP (12+ yrs), Symfony, MySQL, Schema modeling & query optimization, Apache, Nginx
- **APIs & Architecture**: RESTful API design, OAuth2 authentication, Webhooks, Real estate data feeds, hundreds of portal integrations
- **PropTech & CRM**: Multi-tenant CRM architecture, property transaction tools, agent management systems
- **Frontend & Modern Web**: Astro, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3 / Custom CSS design systems
- **AI & Creative Tools**: Generative visual models (Midjourney, Stable Diffusion), OpenAI API, Gemini API, DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro)

## Timeline & Milestones

- **1993-09**: Born in France; grew up between France and Malaysia.
- **2014**: Bachelor's degree (Licence) in Networks & Telecommunications from the University of Sophia-Antipolis.
- **2013-10**: Joined Apimo as Web Developer building core CRM applications, Symfony/MySQL backend services, and property feeds.
- **2017-11**: Stepped into Project Manager role at Apimo leading white-label implementations and development teams.
- **2018-02**: Began representing Apimo at major international industry conferences (Property Portal Watch Bangkok/Madrid, RENT Paris).
- **2022-12**: Promoted to Partnership Manager @ Apimo, overseeing technical integrations, API partnerships, and strategic collaborations.
- **2023-12**: Launched [@Shaun.AI](https://www.instagram.com/shaun.ai/) on Instagram exploring surreal aesthetics and generative digital art.
- **2024-02**: Competed in Runway's GEN:48 AI short film competition with *Burning Canyons*, and ElevenLabs/PikaLabs contest with *Beyond Dreams*.
- **2024-06**: Commissioned by La Banque Postale for their *I.Artistes* challenge (winner by public vote) and subsequent FOOH campaign featured on Brut.
- **2026-08**: Built personal multilingual portfolio website with Astro and AI agentic tools.
